source.title: Special Exceptions to WCRP for March 2024
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Board has recently approved a special set of exceptions to the [WCA Competition Requirements Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf) for competitions taking place in the month of **March 2024**, in anticipation of our upcoming Newcomer Month initiative. 
 <!-- break -->
As part of this initiative, competitions in March 2024 can choose to reserve up to 50% of the competitor limits for WCA Newcomers or cubers with a 2024 WCA ID. The exact details are as follows: 

* **Exception to 5.1**: Up to 50% of the competitor limit may be reserved for competitors without a WCA ID or with a 2024 WCA ID. Registrations for competitions with a specific portion of the competitor limit reserved must not utilize qualification times. If more competitors who qualify for reserved spots register than spots available, they may still be accepted provided the overall competitor limit has not been reached.
* **Addition to 6.2**: Competitions which reserve a specific portion of their competitor limit, must have registration closed no later than 2 weeks prior to the competition. At this point, any competitors on the waiting list who do not qualify for the reserved places may be accepted to the competition until the total competitor limit is filled. If the competitor limit is not filled by the time registration is closed, additional registration periods may be opened. Additional registration periods shall have no reserved places and must be conducted on a "first come first serve" basis.
* **Exception to 6.5.1.1**: Registrations from the waiting list shall be accepted based on qualification for the available spot. Competitors without a WCA ID or with a 2024 WCA ID shall be eligible for any empty spot created by a withdrawal. Competitors with a 2023 WCA ID or earlier shall only qualify for a spot if the withdrawal was by a competitor who did not take up a reserved spot.


We hope that this will provide an opportunity for new cubers in many regions to easily access WCA Competitions around them, and we are looking forward to sharing more about the WCA Newcomer Month in the coming months - stay tuned and follow us on our socials for updates!

translation.title: 2024 年 3 月《WCA 比赛要求政策》特别例外规定
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

为配合即将开展的新手月活动，WCA 董事会近日批准，对 **2024 年 3 月**举行的比赛实施一组[《WCA 比赛要求政策》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf)特别例外规定。

作为活动的一部分，2024 年 3 月的比赛可以选择将最多 50% 的参赛名额预留给 WCA 新人或持有 2024 年 WCA ID 的选手。具体规定如下：

* **第 5.1 条的例外：** 最多可将参赛人数上限的 50% 预留给尚无 WCA ID 或持有 2024 年 WCA ID 的选手。预留部分名额的比赛，不得在报名时设置资格成绩要求。如果报名且符合预留名额条件的选手人数超过预留名额，只要比赛总人数尚未达到上限，仍可接受这些选手的报名。
* **第 6.2 条的补充：** 预留部分名额的比赛，报名必须最迟在比赛开始前 2 周截止。届时，可以从候补名单中接收不符合预留条件的选手，直至总参赛人数达到上限。如果报名截止时人数仍未满，可增开报名时段。增开的报名时段不得设置预留名额，必须遵循“先到先得”的原则。
* **第 6.5.1.1 条的例外：** 候补报名应根据选手是否符合空缺名额的条件来接收。尚无 WCA ID 或持有 2024 年 WCA ID 的选手，可递补任何因退赛产生的空缺；持有 2023 年或更早 WCA ID 的选手，只有在退出者未占用预留名额时，才可递补该空缺。

我们希望这能让更多地区的新魔友更容易参加身边的 WCA 比赛。未来几个月，我们将继续介绍 WCA 新手月活动，请关注我们的社交媒体，留意后续消息！
